owner_photo.discovery_evidence: Path A1 (smart source-site team-page discovery) ran the about-us scrape and matched the filename 'housh-boys.webp' to the brand's known owner-family surname Housh. Cross-referenced with /about-us/the-arrys-team/ which names the family as 'Arry's Roofing Services, Inc. was originally started and managed by Arry and Becky Housh. It has truly become a family business over the ensuing years as Stephen and Matthew Housh have joined the Management Team.' The photo shows 3 men in casual shirts — center figure has the gray hair + light mustache + warm face that matches the /about-us/our-mission letter signed 'James "Arry" Housh'. Surrounding men are Stephen Housh (left, dark blue button-up) and Matthew Housh (right, plaid). Cutout produced via agentic/tools/remove-bg.sh Path B — alpha mean = 0.557 (passes the <0.85 SOP threshold).
